key_path: Go to dashboard.sarvam.ai, which redirects to indus.sarvam.ai/login (signup method is not documented anywhere in the docs)
Sign up; an organisation and a default workspace are created automatically
₹100 free credits on signup, no card
Dashboard > API Keys (key-management) > create a key, shown once
export SARVAM_API_KEY and call the API (api-subscription-key or Bearer header)
human_gates: captcha (the login page sits behind a Cloudflare challenge; a non-browser fetch gets 403 'Attention Required')

agent_native_auth.cli_login_browser_or_device: no. 'Sarvam Code' (coding agent / CLI) page says 'coming soon'
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: no. The auth docs say keys must be generated by hand in the dashboard
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: partial. Workspace-scoped keys, but no per-key or per-workspace spend caps (FAQ). Rate limits are per account, not per key

mcp.product_mcp: local only. `uvx sarvam-mcp` (github.com/sarvamai/sarvam-mcp, 34 stars, pushed 2026-10-08) wraps every public API (STT, TTS, translate, transliterate, LID, LLM, Vision). Uses the SARVAM_API_KEY env var or ~/.sarvam/credentials. No hosted or OAuth server
mcp.one_click_install: no deeplinks. Copy-paste JSON plus a config-path table for Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Windsurf and Zed

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://docs.sarvam.ai/llms.txt. It starts with rendered landing-page prose before the agent instructions and index; per-product /api/llms.txt is clean
docs_for_agents.llms_full_txt: https://docs.sarvam.ai/llms-full.txt, byte-identical to llms.txt (14KB), so not a real full export
docs_for_agents.openapi: no public spec found (docs.sarvam.ai/openapi.json returns HTML)
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: Agent Skills (github.com/sarvamai/skills) covering SDK gotchas; meta-prompt guide

score_justification: Free credits with no card, a complete local MCP and good skills, but no agent-native auth, no hosted MCP, a bot-blocked login, a broken llms-full and some stale docs.
best_practice: Agent Skills document the SDK's non-obvious behaviour (silently ignored params, content=None), aimed at what models tend to get wrong.
biggest_gap: No way for an agent to get a credential without a human in the dashboard: no CLI login, no OAuth MCP, no key API. The dashboard returns a Cloudflare challenge to non-browser clients.
notes_out_of_date: The auth docs still say 'Organisational level keys ... will be available soon', but organisations and workspaces with workspace keys are documented elsewhere. The homepage links 'Coding Agents' to a 'coming soon' page. llms-full.txt is a copy of llms.txt.
